name: olive-remote-lab
description: A private local-network remote for compatible legacy music servers.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/olive-client && concurrently -k -n proxy,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @olive-remote-lab/proxy" "npm run dev -w @olive-remote-lab/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/olive-client && npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/proxy && npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.android:debug: npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/olive-client && npm run android:debug -w @olive-remote-lab/web
scripts.android:bundle:unsigned: npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/olive-client && npm run android:bundle:unsigned -w @olive-remote-lab/web
scripts.android:release: npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/olive-client && npm run android:release -w @olive-remote-lab/web
scripts.ios:build: npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/olive-client && npm run ios:build -w @olive-remote-lab/web
scripts.ios:archive: npm run build -w @olive-remote-lab/olive-client && npm run ios:archive -w @olive-remote-lab/web
